This is a massive drain — the tokens actually held by intents.near collapse from ~4.45M to ~2,411 while the internal ledger still claims ~3.84M supply. This is the exploit in progress: someone is draining the actual collateral while ledger entries remain.

3. The protocol pledges full reimbursement.

- Tracing/recovery of stolen funds.
